finalText:
**Redis went down, and the service slowly starved.**

```
02:14:07  redis gone, ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:08  cache miss storm, every read hits the store
02:14:10  first 5s timeouts, queue at 52
02:29:12  queue passes its own limit of 500
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory
02:31:52  supervisor kills the process group, service down
```

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries were refused.
No request was served after 02:14:03. Everything just hung.
Nothing shed load. The queue climbed to 568 and stayed.

Start with why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused every connection.
